title: Conformal Prediction for Molecular Properties under Label Shift
abstract: arXiv:2608.17678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Drug discovery and development underpins healthcare but remains costly and failure-prone. A critical bottleneck lies in predicting molecular properties such as solubility, potency, and toxicity, which directly determine whether a candidate can advance from preclinical to clinical trials. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has accelerated this process, yet its reliability is often undermined by distribution shift, as experimental conditions frequently diverge from training data. In addition, conventional point predictions provide only single-value estimates, offering limited guidance for high-stakes experimental design. We address these challenges with a conformal prediction framework tailored to label shift. By weighting conformal scores using marginal label probability ratios, our method produces statistically rigorous prediction intervals without retraining. This enables robust uncertainty quantification even when property distributions drif

translated_title: 标签偏移下分子属性的共形预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17678v1 公告类型：新 摘要：药物发现与开发支撑着医疗保健，但仍然成本高昂且易失败。一个关键瓶颈在于预测分子属性，如溶解度、效力和毒性，这些属性直接决定候选药物能否从临床前阶段推进到临床试验。人工智能（AI）加速了这一过程，但其可靠性常因分布偏移而受损，因为实验条件往往偏离训练数据。此外，传统的点预测仅提供单值估计，对高风险实验设计的指导有限。我们通过一种针对标签偏移定制的共形预测框架来解决这些挑战。通过使用边际标签概率比加权共形分数，我们的方法无需重新训练即可生成统计上严格的预测区间。即使在属性分布漂移时，这也能实现稳健的不确定性量化。
tldr: 提出了一种基于标签偏移的共形预测框架，通过加权共形分数生成无需重训的严格预测区间，实现对分子属性分布漂移下的稳健不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: A conformal prediction framework tailored to label shift is proposed, which weights conformal scores to generate rigorous prediction intervals without retraining, enabling robust uncertainty quantification for molecular properties under distribution drift.
